task:
Ranger <Ranger>, Elus game tournament will soon take place on planet <ToPlanet> in the <ToStar> system. Winners in this game are highly esteemed among us, the Faeyans, and get the honorary lifelong elunie title. Unfortunately, our planet's representative won't be able to take part in the tournament because of his sudden illness. We consider you intelligent enough to participate in the tournament as our representative. If you manage to become elunie, you will get a fee in the amount of <Money> cr on return. But note, that you should be on <ToPlanet> by <Date>.
Good luck!
success: Our congratulations, elunie <Ranger>! We are happy that we made a good shot and weren't mistaken about your intellect. Here is your fee - <Money> cr.
loc.1.0: The tournament aroused a great boom in spite of the fact that <clr>Elus<clrEnd> was not so very popular among other races except for the Faeyans. You checked in as a participant in the tournament and went to the hotel. After shower you decided to think over your next steps.
loc.2.0:
From the further conversation with Max you found out the following information:
- 8 figures are used in Elus game. They differ in <clr>colour<clrEnd> (blue and yellow), <clr> size <clrEnd> (small and big), and <clr>type<clrEnd> (lozenges and circles).
- Before the beginning of each round they set some <clr>rule<clrEnd>, according to which the players will choose figures during the round to dispose them in line. But the players don't know this rule.
- In the beginning computer disposes 3 figures in line. The first one is chosen occasionally, and the remaining two - to satisfy the set rule.
- To move, the player chooses one of the offered figures. If this figure satisfies the rule, then it is disposed in the end of the line. If not, the player gets <clr>a penalty <clrEnd>.
- <clr>only one <clrEnd> of all offered figures satisfies the rule.
- The round is over when there is a line of <clr>8<clrEnd> figures.
- If the player makes <clr>4<clrEnd> errors per one round, he is disqualified.
- The tournament consists of <clr>3<clrEnd> rounds.
- The players with the minimum aggregate number of penalties after the total of three rounds become <clr>elunies<clrEnd>.
loc.3.0:
In the morning you came to the championship place and went quickly through the checking procedure the aim of which was to detect electronic devices that could interfere with the computer work. Then you sat at the table with your name on it. The computer that was sitting on the table said:
- Welcome, <Ranger>. Wait a moment.
In about ten minutes the rest of the tables were occupied as well. You ran an eye over your opponents. Most of them were Faeyan but you also noticed a couple of Human faces.

The tournament began. One of the referees came to you, opened up an envelope with the superscription "The set of rules for the first round ", took out a disk and inserted it into the computer.
- Begin, - he said.
loc.21.0:
When you returned to your ship, you wrote in your diary: 
"It's just not my day today. My luck was out but this is not the reason to get upset! I got through to the final round and not everybody can do it. It's a pity, of course, that I won't get <Money> cr, but money makes nobody happy. I'd rather go and shoot dominators. It will liven me up!"
loc.22.0:
You approached O'Nyke and said:

- My congratulations, elunie O'Nyke!  You were at your best. Good for you.

Saying this you gripped his hand so hard that your opponent screamed with pain and wrestled his hand from yours waving it. And suddenly some metallic thing fell out of his sleeve. You were faster than O'Nyke and grabbed it. The thing turned out to be a small laptop of, in all appearances, Peleng assembly. You were surprised. How did he manage to get through the checking procedure with it? Before sitting to the table, each player went through the special detector, which checked him for such devices.

-Well well, - the approached referee said, - we'll look into the matter.

During the investigation it turned out that a special hacking program was installed on the laptop, which analysed the situation before each move and put a small dot over the necessary figure. If anybody had looked from behind O'Nyke's back at the screen, he wouldn't have noticed that dot or would have paid no attention to it - so small it was. That analyser was extremely good, almost infallible. The laptop itself was hidden in the secret pocket near the wrist. And the pocket was of a special material that made the laptop undetectable.
After a council, the referees announced their verdict:

- As long as O'Nyke broke the game rules, his scores are nullified! O'Nyke himself is deprived of the elunie title and the right to take part in all future Elus tournaments. His name will be put in the Disgrace Book forever. According to the tournament rules, the elunie title is adjudged to all players who came in a close second!

So, you still managed to get the honorary <clr>Elunie<clrEnd> title! You couldn't but remembered the famous quote: "Be able to feel happy for others too". He was so damn right!

After the awarding ceremony and the press conference you returned to the ship high-spirited. On your way through the space you wrote in your diary: "I won a very challenging game today and there are <Money> cr waiting for me on <FromPlanet>. Life is a poem!"
loc.22.1:
You shared the first place with the other participants! According to the old Faeyan tradition, the sportsmen were equally rewarded if they demonstrated the same level of intellect. So you got the dear <clr>elunie<clrEnd> title!

After the awarding ceremony and the press conference you returned to the ship high-spirited. On your way through the space you wrote in your diary: "I won a very challenging game today and there are <Money> cr waiting for me on <FromPlanet>. Life is a poem!"
loc.22.2:
You not only took the premier place but also made fewer errors than any other participant!
It hadn't happened in the history of Elus game for a long time already. After a council, the referees not only adjudged the dear <clr>Elunie<clrEnd> title to you but also gave you a <clr>1000<clrEnd> cr bonus! Now you have [p24] cr on your account.

After the awarding ceremony and the press conference you returned to the ship high-spirited. On your way through the space you wrote in your diary: "I won a very challenging game today and there are <Money> cr waiting for me on <FromPlanet>. Life is a poem!"
loc.26.0: There is a line of figures in front of you. There is a number of figures in the lower part of the screen including those you need to choose. Which figure will you choose?
loc.29.0: - THIS IS YOUR <clr>FIRST<clrEnd> ERROR IN THIS ROUND! - the computer announced.
loc.29.1: - THIS IS YOUR <clr>SECOND <clrEnd> ERROR IN THIS ROUND! - the computer announced.
loc.29.2: - THIS IS YOUR <clr>THIRD<clrEnd> ERROR IN THIS ROUND! - the computer announced. - ANY MORE ERRORS AND YOU WILL BE DISQUALIFIED.
loc.29.3:
- THIS IS YOUR <clr>FORTH<clrEnd> ERROR! - the computer announced. 

The referee approached you and said:
- This is your forth error in the round! According to the tournament rules you are disqualified! How did it come that you got into the list of participants at all?
loc.30.0:
You made the right choice and the figure moved to the end of the line. 

"What is next, I wonder?" - you thought.
loc.32.0:
On the way to the ship, all your thoughts were concentrated on two things. The first thing was that you should have paid more attention to your intellectual development at school. The second one was money that you'll never get on <FromPlanet>. 

And only after settling yourself in the pilot's seat, you said to yourself:
- It's all right, <Ranger>. It's just not your day today. Your luck is out but this is not the reason to get upset. Probably, you'll have better luck next time.

Your heart was higher and you started the motor.
loc.39.0: - No more place in the line, - the computer announced.
loc.40.0:
- No problem, - Max said. - "Choose a figure of the same colour as the last one in the line", "Choose a figure of a different colour ", "If the last figure is yellow, choose a big figure, if not, choose a small one ", "If the last figure is big, choose a lozenge, if not, choose a blue figure ", "If the last figure is a lozenge, choose a blue figure, if not, choose a figure of the same size "...
- Aha, - you interrupted, - so my choice of the next figure depends <clr>on the last figure in the line <clrEnd> only, doesn't it?
- That's right, - your interlocutor said.
- So...to win, I must <clr>nick the rule <clrEnd>?
- Are you a participant in the tournament? - Max asked.
- Yes, - you answered.
- Strike me pink! I would never have thought! - he was astonished. - As far as I remember, you constantly confounded the dividend with the divisor at school... But you know, you'll have to nick the rule several times. There are 3 rounds in the tournament, and every each rule becomes trickier!
jump.2.desc:
You came down to the bar and were deciding what to order when somebody called you by name. You turned around and saw a man of average height with dark hair and glasses standing in front of you. You were surprised to recognise Max, your former classmate, in him.
After shaking hands, you asked:
- Max, by what chance are you here?
- You know, I'm working on the doctorate thesis  "Elus and its influence on Fai culture ", - he answered. - Tomorrow's tournament is just a huge pile of invaluable material for me!
- This is interesting, - you said. - Tell me about it.
- With pleasure! You know, the rules of the game have been changing through the ages but the basis remained the same...

- Let's do it, - you said to yourself.
